title: Garden
statementMd:
Vasya has a very beautiful country garden that can be represented as an $*n* × *m*$ rectangular field divided into $*n*·*m*$ squares. One beautiful day Vasya remembered that he needs to pave roads between $*k*$ important squares that contain buildings. To pave a road, he can cover some squares of his garden with concrete.

For each garden square we know number $*a*_{*i*}_{*j*}$ that represents the number of flowers that grow in the square with coordinates $(*i*, *j*)$. When a square is covered with concrete, all flowers that grow in the square die.

Vasya wants to cover some squares with concrete so that the following conditions were fulfilled:

- all $*k*$ important squares should necessarily be covered with concrete
- from each important square there should be a way to any other important square. The way should go be paved with concrete-covered squares considering that neighboring squares are squares that have a common side
- the total number of dead plants should be minimum

As Vasya has a rather large garden, he asks you to help him.

## Input

The first input line contains three integers $*n*$, $*m*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 100$, $*n*·*m* ≤ 200$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ *min*(*n*·*m*, 7$)) — the garden's sizes and the number of the important squares. Each of the next $*n*$ lines contains $*m*$ numbers $*a*_{*i*}_{*j*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}_{*j*} ≤ 1000$) — the numbers of flowers in the squares. Next $*k*$ lines contain coordinates of important squares written as "$*x*$ $*y*$" (without quotes) ($1 ≤ *x* ≤ *n*$, $1 ≤ *y* ≤ *m*$). The numbers written on one line are separated by spaces. It is guaranteed that all $*k*$ important squares have different coordinates.

## Output

In the first line print the single integer — the minimum number of plants that die during the road construction. Then print $*n*$ lines each containing $*m*$ characters — the garden's plan. In this plan use character "`X`" (uppercase Latin letter X) to represent a concrete-covered square and use character "." (dot) for a square that isn't covered with concrete. If there are multiple solutions, print any of them.
statementZhMd:
Vasya 有一个非常美丽的乡村花园，可以表示为一个 $*n* × *m*$ 的矩形区域，被划分为 $*n*·*m*$ 个方格。美好的一天，Vasya 想起他需要在包含建筑物的 $*k*$ 个重要方格之间铺设道路。为了铺设道路，他可以用混凝土覆盖花园中的一些方格。

对于每个花园方格，我们知道一个数字 $*a*_{*i*}_{*j*}$，表示坐标为 $(*i*, *j*)$ 的方格中生长的花朵数量。当一个方格被混凝土覆盖时，该方格中生长的所有花朵都会死亡。

Vasya 希望用混凝土覆盖一些方格，使得满足以下条件：

- 所有 $*k*$ 个重要方格都必须被混凝土覆盖；
- 从每个重要方格都应当存在一条通往其他任意重要方格的路径。这条路径必须经过被混凝土覆盖的方格，并且相邻方格指具有公共边的方格；
- 死去植物的总数最少。

由于 Vasya 的花园相当大，他请你帮助他。

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*m*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 100$，$*n*·*m* ≤ 200$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *min*(*n*·*m*, 7$），分别表示花园的大小和重要方格的数量。接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含 $*m*$ 个数 $*a*_{*i*}_{*j*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}_{*j*} ≤ 1000$），表示各方格中的花朵数量。接下来的 $*k*$ 行包含重要方格的坐标，格式为 "$*x*$ $*y*$"（不含引号）（$1 ≤ *x* ≤ *n*$，$1 ≤ *y* ≤ *m*$）。同一行中的数字用空格分隔。保证所有 $*k*$ 个重要方格的坐标各不相同。

## 输出格式

第一行输出一个整数，即道路建设过程中死亡的植物数量的最小值。然后输出 $*n*$ 行，每行包含 $*m*$ 个字符，表示花园的方案。在方案中，使用字符 "`X`"（大写拉丁字母 X）表示被混凝土覆盖的方格，使用字符 "`.`"（点号）表示未被混凝土覆盖的方格。如果有多个方案，输出任意一个即可。
